payload.rationale: The obligation asks which of eight Outfall 001 parameters have numeric exceedance limits versus report-only monitoring. The packet supplies limit-table excerpts for only three parameter rows (Flow, Dissolved Copper, Total Suspended) and does not include rows or spans for dissolved cadmium, hardness, total aluminum, or total copper. Per-parameter assessment from grounded excerpts: Flow — REJECT (both limit columns read Report MGD; no numeric exceedance comparison). Dissolved copper — REJECT (limit columns read Report). TSS monthly average — REJECT (Report in the monthly-average limit column of the Total Suspended row). TSS daily maximum — ACCEPT (numeric limit 50 in the daily-maximum column of the same row). Dissolved cadmium, hardness, total aluminum, and total copper — cannot be adjudicated; their operative limits are absent from the packet, and absence is not grounds for closed-world REJECT or ACCEPT. Because applicability is mixed across parameters present in the excerpt and unknown for four listed parameters, the collective obligation remains UNRESOLVED rather than collapsed to a single ACCEPT or REJECT.
